OrderSnap for WhatsApp

Your menu becomes an order page. Orders land in your WhatsApp.

OrderSnap turns a small food seller's menu into one shareable page. Customers tap what they want, check the total, and send you a tidy order message on WhatsApp. No app to install, no commission, no card payment to set up.

Add your menu

    Questions sellers ask

    Does OrderSnap take a cut of my sales?

    No. Orders go straight to your WhatsApp and customers pay you directly, the way they already do — cash on delivery, bank transfer, JazzCash or Easypaisa. This demo takes no payment at all.

    Do my customers need an app or an account?

    No. The page opens in any phone browser. The customer picks items, adds their name, and taps one button — WhatsApp opens with the order already written out.

    What happens when I change my prices?

    Edit the menu in the My shop tab and save. In this demo your shop is stored in this browser on this device, so the change shows here right away.

    Is this demo connected to a real bakery?

    No. The Weekend Baker is a sample shop with sample prices. Until you enter your own WhatsApp number in My shop, the order button points at a placeholder demo number.

    OrderSnap for WhatsApp — a demo page. Orders are composed on this page and sent through WhatsApp; OrderSnap never sees or stores them. Demo bakery photos are for illustration.
